onboarding.nameHint: We only use it inside the app.
onboarding.previousTherapy: Has your child seen a speech therapist before?
onboarding.concernsTitle: What made you look for help?
onboarding.consentIntro: Lisan listens to your child's voice to find the tricky sounds. You stay in control.
onboarding.consentRecording: I allow Lisan to record and analyse my child's voice for screening and practice.
onboarding.consentRecordingHint: Required. Recordings are encrypted and you can delete them any time.
onboarding.consentResearch: I allow anonymised recordings to help improve the model (optional).
onboarding.consentResearchHint: Reviewed by speech therapists. You can withdraw any time.
onboarding.doneBody: Next, hand the device to {{name}} for a 10-minute screening game. Sit nearby — no need to help.
